screening_reasoning: CNN (+SLIC superpixel) detection/identification of individual citrus/crop TREES from UAV multispectral imagery; an individual-tree recognition task in the fruit-orchard domain, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.

CamelinaWeed is a UAV RGB and multispectral dataset for weed and crop monitoring and mapping in camelina, providing annotated aerial imagery for weed/crop segmentation; the truncated abstract confirms UAV weed-crop monitoring scope though reported quantitative segmentation metrics are not shown here.

SCG-UNet performs semantic segmentation of weeds in soybean fields from fused UAV RGB+multispectral imagery, reporting mIoU 83.43%, Dice 79.50%, and F1 80.77% - a direct UAV crop/weed segmentation study with quantitative pixel-wise metrics.
A review of intelligent technologies for orchard yield monitoring; survey without a primary UAV crop/weed segmentation benchmark.
DPI-LSTM estimates UAV position/attitude from IMU data (drone racing benchmark); an inertial-navigation learning task, unrelated to agricultural crop/weed segmentation.

U-Net pixel-based weed/crop classification on UAV maize datasets (MicaSense vs low-cost multispectral) reports weed-class F1 (82% Altum, 76% low-cost) with precision/recall, a UAV crop/weed semantic-segmentation study with quantitative metrics.
CNN-GRU estimates jujube-tree leaf area index from UAV RGB time-series (vegetation-index regression); a phenotyping regression task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.

Multi-head UNet++ provides unified five-class pixel-level semantic segmentation of crop water stress and rust disease from UAV multispectral orthomosaics, reporting mIoU 0.8623, i.e., UAV crop semantic segmentation with quantitative pixel metrics.
MFD-YOLO instance-segments lychee CANOPY regions in UAV orchard imagery (mAP50, low latency); an orchard fruit-canopy monitoring task outside crop/weed management scope.
The TomatoWeedDet dataset described uses YOLO-based multi-class weed bounding-box detection (44,165 boxes, mAP); a detection task without pixel-level segmentation masks.
A three-phase CNN framework classifies crop health from drone/satellite multispectral data (>90% accuracy); a whole-image health-classification task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.
BaleUAVision is a hay-bale detection/counting UAV dataset (YOLOv11 precision/recall); a postharvest logistics detection task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.

MSCNN-VSS performs multiscale CNN-state-space semantic segmentation of crop disease from UAV imagery, reporting Pixel Accuracy 0.9421 and mIoU 0.9152 - UAV crop pixel-level segmentation with quantitative metrics.
MADRL optimizes dual-battery energy in UAV FANET communication for search-and-rescue; a network/energy-optimization task, not agricultural crop/weed segmentation.
A UAV RGB+multispectral dataset with expert polygon masks explicitly for semantic segmentation of weedy rice in cultivated rice fields, directly supporting UAV crop/weed segmentation research.
IWQWO-ViT addresses WSN intrusion detection and environmental monitoring in smart agriculture; a network-security/sensing task, not UAV crop/weed segmentation.
An improved Faster R-CNN detects/counts wheat spikes from UAV images; a bounding-box detection/counting task, not pixel-level segmentation.
Weed detection in teff from UAV imagery evaluates fine-tuned classifiers (MobileNetV2 96.40% accuracy); an image-classification task rather than pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
ConViTX is a lightweight Conv-ViT for plant-DISEASE classification (accuracy on maize/datasets); a whole-image classification task without UAV aerial crop/weed segmentation.
DASNet counts sheep from UAV density-map regression (Sheep1500 dataset); a livestock-counting task outside crop/weed management.
CNN/MLP estimate rice canopy leaf area index from UAV multispectral imagery (LAI regression); a phenotyping/trait regression task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.
CBAM-ECA-DeepLabv3+ segments fruit-tree canopies for apple YIELD estimation (mIoU 0.89) with SVM/ML yield models; an orchard-fruit yield-estimation task outside crop/weed segmentation.

DM_CorrMatch performs semi-supervised semantic segmentation of rapeseed inflorescence/coverage from UAV imagery (Mamba-DeepLabv3+, IoU 0.886), a UAV crop pixel-level segmentation study with quantitative accuracy.
CMTNet performs hyperspectral CROP-TYPE classification (WHU-Hi datasets, overall accuracy); a per-pixel crop-type classification task rather than crop-vs-weed semantic segmentation.
A comprehensive review of deep learning for abiotic crop stress assessment; survey without a primary UAV crop/weed segmentation benchmark.
